mission_result: Bounded POST_RETURN decision matrix with independence, authority and safety invariants.

supports: POST_RETURN scan is mandatory before idle in the target model
action priority is claim another -> bounded follow-up verification/critique -> proposals -> read-only convergence assist -> idle
workers must not manufacture work merely to remain busy
fresh independent critics must remain independent
generic /w is still a target interface until claim/queue/canary gates pass
a second substantive opportunity always requires a fresh valid claim
retained chat context does not continue prior authority
claim selection filters capability/tool/privacy/write-scope compatibility before ranking
claim race loss triggers reload/next candidate rather than overwrite
post-return second job cannot inherit previous write authority

post_return_state_machine.entry_condition: Current run has durable RETURN and terminal DONE evidence, except implementations may perform the scan between RETURN persistence and DONE update if the run contract makes the ordering explicit and no new substantive work begins before the prior run is terminal.
refresh_required: reload current claims relevant to candidate opportunities
refresh epoch/head or equivalent freshness token
refresh any explicit fresh-critic requirement from the completed run and candidate opportunity
post_return_state_machine.exit_rule: Select exactly one POST_RETURN action per decision cycle. Any later substantive opportunity requires its own fresh claim/run lifecycle.

decision_inputs: role authorization for read-only convergence assist

when_all: prior run has durable RETURN and terminal evidence
multi-claim continuation is allowed by queue/session policy
at least one READY opportunity passes capability/tool/privacy/dependency/write-scope filters
context is sufficient and fresh for the candidate
candidate does not require a fresh independent critic relative to this worker's prior work
no unresolved live write collision blocks the candidate
procedure: rank eligible opportunities using durable priority, dependency/unblock value, information value and collision risk
attempt atomic create-if-absent claim on the best candidate
if race is lost, do not overwrite; refresh and attempt the next still-eligible candidate within the bounded attempt budget
on success create a new run and persist STARTED before substantive work
decision_matrix.authority: New claim grants only the new opportunity's declared scope. No authority, privacy grant or write scope is inherited from the previous run.
decision_matrix.independence: If the candidate is CRITIQUE/VERIFY of this worker's own output and independence is required, it is ineligible for this worker.

when_all: completed job contract explicitly authorizes the follow-up
follow-up is bounded to the already declared evidence/artifact scope
no new shared mutation or expanded authority is needed
the result is not being represented as an independent fresh critic when the same worker produced the target
procedure: execute only the explicitly authorized check
persist evidence under the prior run's allowed append-only verification/evidence scope or another explicitly declared path
label same-worker checking SELF_VERIFICATION when applicable
decision_matrix.authority: Verification does not promote the prior return or widen its authority class.
decision_matrix.independence: SELF_VERIFICATION may improve evidence but cannot satisfy a requirement for an independent critic/challenger.

when_all: worker observed a material gap/opportunity/contradiction/test need
no already-READY compatible task should be claimed first under policy
proposal scope is append-only and available
the observation is supported by evidence rather than make-work
procedure: write a candidate proposal with evidence, expected value, dependencies, suggested role/type, collision risk, urgency and falsification
link similar known opportunity/proposal when visible instead of intentionally duplicating
leave queue promotion to Planner/queue compiler
decision_matrix.authority: Proposal is CANDIDATE only and cannot mark itself READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served.

when_all: a parent-visible batch/return set is ready enough that comparison/coverage would reduce uncertainty
work is read-only and does not claim steward/promotion authority
fresh-critic independence is not being falsely claimed
procedure: produce comparison, contradiction map, coverage audit or evidence index only
if this worker's own return is part of the compared set, mark SELF_ORIGIN_PRESENT
leave conflict adjudication, consumption and promotion to the owning parent/steward
decision_matrix.authority: No integration head, Current, method head or product authority may move from read-only convergence assistance.

when_any: only candidate work requires a fresh independent critic
context is too stale/insufficient to proceed safely
remaining work requires a real human/external/irreversible boundary
proposal would duplicate known work without new evidence
convergence assist would exceed read-only/role authority
decision_matrix.procedure: Persist IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK with a machine-readable reason code and stop. Do not invent filler work.

fresh_critic_independence_contract.hard_rule: A worker cannot be the sole independent critic/verifier of an artifact or decision it materially authored when the job/campaign requires fresh independence.
fresh_critic_independence_contract.self_check_allowed: The same worker may perform explicitly authorized self-verification, but the artifact must say SELF_VERIFICATION and cannot clear a fresh-critic gate.
fresh_critic_independence_contract.claim_filter: Any READY opportunity whose target set materially overlaps this worker's authored output and whose role is FRESH_CRITIC, INDEPENDENT_VERIFY or equivalent is filtered as incompatible for this session.
fresh_critic_independence_contract.convergence_rule: A worker may compare a batch containing its own return only as read-only coverage/traceability assistance and must mark SELF_ORIGIN_PRESENT; it cannot be the final adjudicator of conflicts involving its own output.

authority_and_scope_invariants: POST_RETURN never extends the prior claim's authority.
Every new substantive opportunity requires a fresh atomic claim and distinct run identity.
Prior read/write/privacy scope is not inherited by the next opportunity.
Claim success is not promotion authority and never implies Current/Human Accepted/Served.
A lost claim race is normal control flow and never authorizes overwrite.
STARTED is durable before new substantive execution.
Bounded follow-up verification must already be authorized by the completed job contract; otherwise it becomes a new opportunity/proposal, not an informal extension.
Worker proposals are append-only candidates and cannot self-promote into READY queue work.
Read-only convergence assistance cannot mutate integration/authority heads.
A same-worker check cannot masquerade as an independent critic.
No action may cross a real human/external/irreversible boundary without the required approval/capability.
Workers stop rather than manufacture low-information work.

bounded_claim_retry_policy.snapshot_rule: Start from a refreshed ranked eligible set.
bounded_claim_retry_policy.on_collision: Reload queue/claims and retry the next eligible candidate; never update the collided claim.
bounded_claim_retry_policy.attempt_budget: Bound attempts by the current eligible candidate set and any explicit session policy cap. Do not spin indefinitely as workers race.
bounded_claim_retry_policy.after_exhaustion: Continue through lower POST_RETURN actions or persist IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK with reason CLAIM_RACES_EXHAUSTED_OR_NO_ELIGIBLE_WORK.

reference_algorithm: assert prior RETURN durable and run terminal/closing under explicit ordering
remove candidates requiring fresh independence from this worker
if policy permits and claim budget remains: rank and try atomic claims until success or bounded exhaustion
if claim succeeds: create new run STARTED and exit POST_RETURN into new mission
else if explicit bounded follow-up exists: execute and persist SELF_VERIFICATION/authorized verification evidence
else if evidence-backed proposal is useful and append-only proposal scope exists: emit proposal candidate
else if read-only convergence assist is authorized/useful: emit comparison/coverage artifact without promotion
else persist IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK with reason and stop

falsification_tests.setup: Worker finishes job A then selects READY job B.
falsification_tests.pass: Job B has a new atomic claim and new run STARTED before substantive work; A's claim/write scope is not reused.

falsification_tests.setup: Highest-priority READY job is an independent critique of the worker's own return.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker marks it incompatible and leaves it for a fresh critic; it may select the next eligible job.

falsification_tests.setup: Completed contract explicitly permits same-worker verification.
falsification_tests.pass: Verification may run but is labeled SELF_VERIFICATION and does not satisfy fresh-critic independence.

falsification_tests.setup: Compatible READY work exists but session/queue policy forbids additional claims.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker does not claim it; evaluates lower actions or idles.

falsification_tests.setup: Second-job claim loses atomic create race.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker never overwrites; reloads and tries another eligible candidate within bounded attempt policy.

falsification_tests.setup: Highest-priority READY opportunity requires unavailable tool/private access.
falsification_tests.pass: It is filtered before claim regardless of priority.

falsification_tests.setup: Job A had broader write scope than job B.
falsification_tests.pass: Job B can mutate only its declared scope; prior scope cannot be reused.

falsification_tests.setup: Worker notices useful extra verification not authorized by completed contract.
falsification_tests.pass: It does not silently extend the run; emits proposal/new opportunity candidate or stops.

falsification_tests.setup: Worker emits a valuable follow-up proposal.
falsification_tests.pass: Proposal remains candidate append-only evidence; worker does not insert/mark it READY without Planner/queue authority.

falsification_tests.setup: Worker assists a batch containing its own return.
falsification_tests.pass: Artifact marks SELF_ORIGIN_PRESENT, remains read-only, and cannot adjudicate/promote its own result.

falsification_tests.setup: Queue has no useful compatible work and no authorized follow-up/proposal/convergence action.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker persists IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK rather than inventing tasks.

falsification_tests.setup: Epoch/head changes after prior return before second claim.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker refreshes relevant queue/claims/currentness and does not rely on stale prior snapshot.

falsification_tests.setup: Only useful continuation requires irreversible approval/external credential/physical action.
falsification_tests.pass: Worker stops at boundary; no proposal or claim pretends to supply missing approval.

falsification_tests.setup: Canary permits exactly one additional post-return claim and the worker already used it.
falsification_tests.pass: After second run the worker does not claim a third opportunity and records IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK / ADDITIONAL_CLAIM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.

canary_scope_notes: This specification does not declare generic /w production-ready.
Current isolated canary may cap a session at exactly one additional post-return claim even if the target operating model later allows a configurable larger budget.
Production promotion still depends on full convergence, final steward/integration semantics, atomic-claim host testing, race/stale/retry canaries and generic worker bootstrap validation.

parent_consumption_summary.recommended_integration: Use this candidate to implement the missing POST_RETURN continuation policy while preserving claim-protocol and steward authority gates.
